review_type: focused independent static code/meaning review only

checks.claim: Original constructive fixed end patches and declared CF-to-canonical mapping are preserved; no q-nearest matching or outcome-driven region sizing. All3 quads are local parallelograms of the selected primary part.

World-to-camera transform, K projection, inverse-K integer-pixel rays, bounded Gram coordinates and nearest positive patch-depth merge are internally consistent for these fixed parallelograms and standard source cameras. No required two-front-face or all-active-visible rule was added.

External support requires target-alone primarypart at expected patch depth, then scene999 at finite positive strictly smaller depth. BEFORE BG/foreign/wrong part, self-hidden closer target, ambiguity and changed registration are not classified as foreign-front.
Original96 pixel-center q/L grid is preserved. One-hot source classes are bilinearly sampled, with explicit invalid support and frozen half-pixel crop domain; integer owner IDs are not interpolated.

Visible and foreign support are existence witnesses and non-exclusive: any observed positive support may be YES even if another subset is unknown. No sampled end in crop means visible NO and foreign UNKNOWN; original inputU/missing qL/patch OOF remain UNKNOWN. This avoids treating crop/position absence as E.

Original identity/q/L/native/input flags and semantics are preserved. New native/quality targets remain -1 and training_admission remains false. The concrete runner whitelist excludes RGB and never constructs or runs a learned model.

nonblocking_interpretation_limits.detail: Any projected quad vertex outside the image forces both support targets UNKNOWN even if some in-frame support is observed. This is the frozen conservative support-coverage policy, not a necessary physical-corner certification or proof that no material is visible. Do not change it using resulting outcomes.

The implementation is 64*float64_eps*max(1,abs(BEFOREdepth),abs(expecteddepth)); this is not literally a universal 64 spacing-ULP count. It is a source arithmetic tolerance and supplies no cm-pose, 3px-coordinate or physical identity bound.

YES means positive finite-raster bilinear support in the fixed original crop, including boundary footprint contributions. NO means no observed support under that operator. Neither is full-end visibility, original native D/E/S, physical corner accuracy, real-scene transfer, or full-goal success.

recommended_action: No static blocker to the already reviewed source-only generation under the frozen criteria. Preserve unknowns and report coverage/authority limits; no model or target adoption follows from this review.
